        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_rsi14.Update(aapl_bar.EndTime, aapl_bar.Close)

        if aapl_bar is not None and self.aapl_previous_close is not None:
            if float(aapl_bar.Close) < self.aapl_previous_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        all_bars_present = all(
            symbol in data.Bars
            for symbol in [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]
        )

        if (
            not self.IsWarmingUp
            and all_bars_present
            and spy_bar is not None
            and aapl_bar is not None
        ):
            spy_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            aapl_rsi = float(self.aapl_rsi14.Current.Value)

            strategy_a_buy = (
                self.spy_sma200.IsReady
                and self.spy_previous_close is not None
                and self.spy_previous_sma200 is not None
                and self.spy_previous_close <= self.spy_previous_sma200
                and spy_close > float(self.spy_sma200.Current.Value)
            )

            strategy_a_sell = (
                self.spy_sma50.IsReady
                and self.spy_previous_close is not None
                and self.spy_previous_sma50 is not None
                and self.spy_previous_close >= self.spy_previous_sma50
                and spy_close < float(self.spy_sma50.Current.Value)
            )

            strategy_b_buy = self.aapl_red_streak >= 3

            strategy_b_sell = (
                self.aapl_rsi14.IsReady
                and aapl_rsi > 60
            )

            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and strategy_a_sell:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and strategy_b_sell:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and strategy_a_buy:
                shares = int(
                    0.40 * float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_close
                )
                if shares > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, shares)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = shares

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and strategy_b_buy:
                available_cash = float(self.Portfolio.Cash)
                if available_cash >= 20000:
                    shares = int(20000 / float(aapl_bar.Close))
                    if shares > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, shares)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = shares

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.spy_previous_close = float(spy_bar.Close)
            if self.spy_sma200.IsReady:
                self.spy_previous_sma200 = float(self.spy_sma200.Current.Value)
            if self.spy_sma50.IsReady:
                self.spy_previous_sma50 = float(self.spy_sma50.Current.Value)

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.aapl_previous_close = float(aapl_bar.Close)
